problems.title: The operator cannot convert Platform to v1alpha2
problems.description: Reading Platform objects as v1alpha2 fails: the API server asks the operator's conversion webhook to convert them, and the webhook returns an error. Reading them as v1alpha1 works, so clients of that version keep working. v1alpha2 is the version the API server prefers, so oc get platform and every client that follows discovery fail too. Likely cause (an inference from the message): the conversion webhook served by the running operator does not know v1alpha2. That happens when a nightly's operator image is older than the CRDs its bundle installed.
evidence: GET /apis/config.opendatahub.io/v1alpha2/platforms?limit=1: HTTP 500: conversion webhook for config.opendatahub.io/v1alpha1, Kind=Platform failed: no kind "Platform" is registered for version "config.opendatahub.io/v1alpha2" in scheme "pkg/runtime/scheme.go:111"
problems.fix: Update RHOAI to a newer nightly (Update on the Status page, or a build from Build Explorer), then run diagnostics again. Nothing needs to be changed by hand: this tool keeps reading the version that works, and does not change the CRD.
problems.learnMore: A CRD that serves several versions stores each object in one of them and converts on every read in another, through the conversion webhook of the operator. The webhook can only convert to the versions compiled into the operator image. A newer operator build that knows the version fixes the reads; switching the CRD to conversion strategy None would change how the stored objects are read, so the tool does not do it.
problems.technicalCmd:
oc get --raw '/apis/config.opendatahub.io/v1alpha2/platforms?limit=1' --request-timeout=20s
oc logs -n redhat-ods-operator deploy/rhods-operator | grep conversion-webhook
